changelog: Initial import: 5 records for variable f (World, India, United States, Germany, France; year 2024) from upstream commit f8de88a4f6f9cab44f1cf606047cbd6c4414042c.
description: Grid-average lifecycle greenhouse-gas intensity of electricity generation for the world and four countries in 2024, as published in the Our World in Data (OWID) 'Data on Energy' legacy dataset (variable carbon_intensity_elec). OWID's codebook attributes the variable to Ember's Yearly Electricity Data. Supplies the model input `f` only; it supplies nothing else the rebound model needs.

license.text: OWID states that data it produces is open access under Creative Commons BY and that data produced by third parties is subject to the original authors' license terms; the original (Ember) terms were not checked here.

metadata.row_selection_rule: fixed list: World, India, United States, Germany, France; year 2024; chosen before any model run
metadata.upstream_status: OWID labels this legacy release as no longer updated

methodology: OWID codebook definition (verbatim from the pinned codebook row): 'Greenhouse gases emitted per unit of generated electricity, measured in grams of CO2 equivalents per kilowatt-hour.' Title: 'Lifecycle carbon intensity of electricity generation'. This is a grid-AVERAGE intensity per kWh GENERATED. EcoBackfire notes (not from the source): it is not a marginal factor, it is defined per generated rather than delivered kWh, and the source states no uncertainty. The rebound model's `f` is per kWh of final energy and requires the supplier to state average vs marginal.
provider: Our World in Data (compiler); underlying data: Ember (Yearly Electricity Data 2026; Yearly Electricity Data Europe 2026), as stated in the OWID codebook

raw_files.note: Verbatim lines (header + 5 data rows) of owid-energy-data.csv at upstream commit f8de88a4f6f9cab44f1cf606047cbd6c4414042c; full-file sha256 266f2e2baad7975351bc9bb4aa061d22b1da9fe4c47d51d2ac6071e01e171f76.
Verbatim header + the carbon_intensity_elec row of owid-energy-codebook.csv at the same commit; full-file sha256 3cc9b7db0d921496e2988568ce3aee5ed41f50431dd234a0663b5f0a4b2e32bb.

evidence.description: Lifecycle greenhouse-gas intensity of electricity generation (grid average), per kWh generated
evidence.note: EcoBackfire applicability caveat (not from the source): the source defines this per kWh generated, whereas the model's f is per kWh of final energy delivered, so transmission and distribution losses are not represented; the source gives no uncertainty.

scope.system_description: grid-average electricity generation; average (not marginal); applies only to electricity-consuming devices
